description: Board UI wiring + new components + R1 rename — the user-facing layer. Adds the ZoneNode background node with R5 editable name badge, the ZoneToolbarHost (color + confirm-delete), wires zones/edge-color/z-order/drag-handlers/BoardSelectionToolbar into BoardCanvas, and renames the user-facing 分线头 label to 手柄. Depends on FEAT-001 (store actions, constants, TodoZone type, TodoEdge.color) and FEAT-002 (withAlpha from colorUtils, boardZones helpers). This is the last feature; after it the whole board behavior is complete.
steps: R1 rename (src/components/TodoItemToolbar.tsx): change the handle-toggle button label `'分线头'` -> `'手柄'`, and the two title strings `'取消分线头，恢复为普通任务节点'` -> `'取消手柄，恢复为普通任务节点'` and `'设为分线头（本分线的头节点）'` -> `'设为手柄（本分线的头节点）'`. Leave the isHandle field, store action names, and the non-rendered doc-comment occurrences in src/todoBranchLines.ts and src/types.ts unchanged.

Create src/components/ZoneNode.tsx: a React.memo React Flow node (structurally like DirectoryNode). Root div 100%/100%, rounded, `backgroundColor: withAlpha(zone.color, 0.18)` (import withAlpha from ../colorUtils), border 1px in the zone color at higher alpha, no shadow, no NodeResizer. Reads its zone from the store by data.zoneId (so it re-renders on color/name change). R5 name badge: absolutely positioned top-left, `backgroundColor: zone.color`, white text, rounded, click-to-edit inline <input> with draft state committing on Enter/blur and canceling on Escape (mirror DirectoryNode's name-edit) -> `updateTodoZone(zoneId, { name })`; empty name shows a muted placeholder '分区'. Single click on the zone body (not the badge) opens ZoneToolbarHost via local toolbarOpen state. Badge/input/toolbar elements carry `nodrag nopan` so they don't start a drag.

Create src/components/ZoneToolbar.tsx (ZoneToolbarHost) — may co-locate inside ZoneNode.tsx. Portal toolbar mirroring TodoItemToolbarHost: a full-screen backdrop button that closes it; a ColorPicker with `label='颜色'`, `value={zone.color}`, `onChange={(color) => updateTodoZone(zoneId, { color })}`; a confirm-to-delete button (two-click, like TodoItemToolbarHost) -> `deleteTodoZone(zoneId)`.

BoardCanvas edges (src/components/TodoPage.tsx ~line 842): change the mapped edge object to `style: { stroke: edge.color || LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR, strokeWidth: 2 }` (import LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR from ../store), carry `color` through, and add `zIndex: 2` to every edge object.
BoardCanvas nodes (~line 841): add `zIndex: 1` to every todo node object.

BoardCanvas zone nodes: build `const zoneNodes = todoZones.map(zone => ({ id: zone.id, type: 'zoneNode', position: { x: zone.x, y: zone.y }, width: zone.width, height: zone.height, zIndex: 0, selectable: false, draggable: true, connectable: false, data: { zoneId: zone.id } }))` (read todoZones from the store). Set `nodeTypes = { todoNode: BoardNode, zoneNode: ZoneNode }`. Seed `localNodes` from `nodes` concat `zoneNodes` (both in the useEffect that resets localNodes and the initial useState). Zones are NOT todo items -> exclude them from the visibleItemIds branch filter (they always render).

BoardCanvas drag handlers: add an early branch at the TOP of onNodeDragStart / onNodeDrag / onNodeDragStop: `if (node.type === 'zoneNode') { ...zone path...; return; }` else run the existing todo path unchanged. Zone start: snapshot `computeZoneMoveSet(zone, localNodes, membersByHead)` member ids + each member's start position + the zone's own start (reuse a ref like dragSnapshot). Zone drag: compute dx/dy from the zone's drag position vs its start and translate the zone + every member by (dx,dy) in localNodes (same mechanism as the handle rigid-drag). Zone stop: build `nodeTargets = { memberId: { x: start.x+dx, y: start.y+dy } }` and call `moveTodoZone(zoneId, dx, dy, nodeTargets)` (one persistSet = one undo step). The existing handle path and the selected-nodes else-branch are unchanged; because zones are selectable:false they never enter selectedNodes so the else-branch never calls updateTodoItem on a zone.

BoardCanvas selection toolbar: replace the `selectedNodes.length > 1 ? <DeleteSelectionBar .../> : null` block with a new BoardSelectionToolbar rendered on the SAME `selectedNodes.length > 1` threshold. Compute `selectedNodeIds = new Set(selectedNodes.filter(n => n.type === 'todoNode').map(n => n.id))` and `selectedEdgeIds = allEdges.filter(e => selectedNodeIds.has(e.sourceItemId) && selectedNodeIds.has(e.targetItemId)).map(e => e.id)`. Toolbar entries: label `已选 N 项`; `统一颜色` (ColorPicker) -> `setSelectionColor([...selectedNodeIds], selectedEdgeIds, color)`; `创建分区` -> compute bounds from selected todo nodes using the boardZones bounds helper (nodeSize-based, padded) and call `createTodoZone(bounds)` (disabled when bounds degenerate; does NOT consume/clear the selection); `删除` -> existing removeSelected with confirm-to-delete UX.
Confirm ZoneNode data typing (ZoneNodeData = { zoneId: string }) and that applyNodeChanges on the mixed todo+zone localNodes array still type-checks.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint` exits 0 and `npm run dev` boots clean on port 3123 with no compile/console errors.
`grep -rn '分线头' src/components/*.tsx src/*.tsx` returns no rendered-string hits; the handle-toggle button reads '手柄' and its tooltips use 手柄 (the two .ts doc comments are intentionally retained).
Box-selecting >1 node shows the board toolbar; choosing a color recolors all selected nodes AND every edge whose both endpoints are selected, and only those edges; the change is one undo step.
An edge with no stored color renders in LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR; edges paint above nodes which paint above zones (zIndex 2 > 1 > 0).

创建分区 adds one zone over the selection bounds, rendered beneath nodes/edges, default color '#8D78D5', with an editable top-left name badge in the zone color; clicking a zone opens a toolbar with change-color + delete; deleting removes only the zone and leaves inner nodes in place.

Dragging a zone translates every geometrically-contained node plus the full branch-line of every contained handle (incl. branch nodes outside the rect) by one delta as ONE undo step; dragging a handle moves its branch-line and does NOT move any zone.
Zones + edge colors + zone name persist across a localStorage save/load round-trip (verified against FEAT-001 persistence).
verification: npm run dev — confirm it boots on :3123 with no errors, then stop it.
grep -rn '分线头' src/components/*.tsx src/*.tsx   (expect: no matches in .tsx rendered strings)

Behavioral spot-check (manual or scripted evidence) of each acceptance criterion: new node 176x96, multi-select color on nodes+both-endpoint edges only, 创建分区 z-order + default color + editable badge, zone-drag union-with-handle-branch-lines as one undo, handle-drag leaves zones still, delete-zone keeps inner nodes, persistence round-trip of zone(color+name)+edge color.
Record any deviations or follow-ups in `findings`.
findings:
ALL STEPS IMPLEMENTED. R1: TodoItemToolbar.tsx handle-toggle label '分线头'->'手柄' + both tooltips ('取消手柄，恢复为普通任务节点' / '设为手柄（本分线的头节点）'); isHandle field/action names and the two .ts doc comments (todoBranchLines.ts:23, types.ts:125) intentionally unchanged.

Created src/components/ZoneNode.tsx: React.memo zoneNode reading its zone from the store by data.zoneId. Root div 100%/100% rounded-xl, backgroundColor withAlpha(zone.color, 0.18), 1px border withAlpha(zone.color, 0.6), no shadow/NodeResizer. R5 badge: absolutely positioned top-left, backgroundColor zone.color, white text, click-to-edit inline <input> (draft state, commit on Enter/blur, cancel on Escape via skipBlurCommitRef — mirrors DirectoryNode) -> updateTodoZone(zoneId, { name }); empty name shows muted '分区' placeholder. Single click on zone body (not badge/toolbar) toggles ZoneToolbarHost via local toolbarOpen. Badge/input/toolbar carry nodrag nopan. ZoneToolbarHost co-located inside ZoneNode.tsx: portal + full-screen backdrop button to close; ColorPicker label='颜色' value=zone.color onChange->updateTodoZone({color}); two-click confirm-to-delete -> deleteTodoZone(zoneId). Exported ZoneNodeData = { zoneId: string }.

BoardCanvas wiring (src/components/TodoPage.tsx): imports LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR from ../store, computeZoneMoveSet+selectionBounds from ../boardZones, ZoneNode+ZoneNodeData, ColorPicker. edges mapper now style.stroke = edge.color || LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR, carries color, zIndex:2; todo nodes zIndex:1; zoneNodes built from todoZones (type zoneNode, zIndex:0, selectable:false, draggable:true, connectable:false, data:{zoneId}). nodeTypes = { todoNode: BoardNode, zoneNode: ZoneNode }. localNodes typed BoardOrZoneNode[] = nodes.concat(zoneNodes) in both the initial useState and the reset useEffect; onNodesChange/applyNodeChanges type-check on the mixed array. Added a dedicated zoneDragSnapshot ref and an early `if (node.type === 'zoneNode')` branch at the TOP of onNodeDragStart/onNodeDrag/onNodeDragStop: start snapshots computeZoneMoveSet member start positions + zone start; drag translates zone + members by (dx,dy) exactly like the handle rigid-drag; stop builds nodeTargets and calls moveTodoZone(zoneId, dx, dy, nodeTargets) = one undo step. The handle path and selected-nodes else-branch are unchanged; zones are selectable:false so they never enter selectedNodes. Zones excluded from the visibleItemIds branch filter (zoneNodes derived straight from todoZones, always rendered).

Replaced DeleteSelectionBar with BoardSelectionToolbar at the same `selectedNodes.length > 1` threshold: label '已选 N 项'; 统一颜色 (ColorPicker) -> setSelectionColor([...selectedNodeIds], selectedEdgeIds, color); 创建分区 -> selectionBounds(selected todoNodes) then createTodoZone(bounds), disabled when bounds degenerate, does NOT clear the selection; 删除 keeps the existing confirm-to-delete removeSelected UX. selectedNodeIds = Set of selected type==='todoNode' ids; selectedEdgeIds = allEdges where both endpoints in selectedNodeIds.

VERIFICATION: `npm run lint` (tsc --noEmit) exits 0. `vite --port=3123` boots clean (VITE v6.4.2 ready; only an unrelated Node DEP0205 deprecation warning from a dep) — HTTP 200 for / and for vite transforms of TodoPage.tsx, ZoneNode.tsx, TodoItemToolbar.tsx, boardZones.ts with no transform errors logged; server stopped after. grep '分线头' on src/components/*.tsx + src/*.tsx returns no rendered-string hits (two .ts doc comments retained as designed). Throwaway tsx harness (created under .agents/tasks, deleted after) asserted selectionBounds pad=24 on all sides, computeZoneMoveSet union of contained nodes with a handle's out-of-rect branch members + dedupe + empty-zone-empty-set, and the both-endpoint edge-selection filter — 13/13 assertions passed.

DEVIATIONS: (1) BoardSelectionToolbar's 统一颜色 ColorPicker requires a `value` prop but a multi-selection has no single current color — seeded it with LEGACY_EDGE_COLOR purely as the swatch default; the chosen color is applied via setSelectionColor regardless, so behavior matches the spec (no user-visible impact beyond the initial swatch shown before opening). (2) ZoneToolbarHost positions itself above the zone's top-left anchor (rect.top - 56) mirroring TodoItemToolbarHost; no spec position was given. No new dependencies added.
